propositions: Project routing overlay cannot extend built-in overlay triggers; only standalone project.* criteria are supported today
Built-in overlays (e.g. concurrency, performance) need to accept additive trigger_tokens (literal substrings matched against diff lines) and applies_to globs from project configuration
Helper function project_trigger_extensions must read project overlay's raw code_review entries and return per-overlay-id trigger_tokens and applies_to for union with committed triggers
glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays must union project trigger extensions with committed triggers, preserving current behavior when no project overlay is present
Malformed project trigger entries (non-list trigger_tokens, non-string tokens, unknown overlay ids) must be silently ignored without raising exceptions
